rules.why: The Resource Graph's zoom, Fit View and interactivity buttons sit in a row at the bottom centre (frontend/src/pages/ResourceGraph.tsx, 0ccf607e9), where v0.7.8 drew them in the bottom-left corner under the legend.
The sidebar's HTTPRoutes icon (Route, frontend/src/components/kindIcons.ts) is drawn mirrored by lucide-react 1.77.0 (frontend/package-lock.json, 1767b08df), where v0.7.8 had 1.70.0.

The sidebar's CronJobs icon (CalendarClock, frontend/src/components/kindIcons.ts) is drawn with a smaller clock by lucide-react 1.77.0 (frontend/package-lock.json, 1767b08df), where v0.7.8 had 1.70.0.

The CronJob drawer's kind icon (CalendarClock, frontend/src/components/resource-detail/ResourceDetailHeader.tsx) is drawn with a smaller clock by lucide-react 1.77.0 (frontend/package-lock.json, 1767b08df), where v0.7.8 had 1.70.0.

A long alert name is cut to two lines (frontend/src/pages/alerts/AlertInbox.tsx, 81f6eda1e), where v0.7.8 drew all of it, on a third line: block beside line-clamp-2 turned the cut off. The rows under it move up and the fitting table can hold one more.
